When I said Art of Balance was going to be kiddie waggle nonsense, I lied. THIS, however, is 100% Kiddie Waggle Nonsense.

I weirdly hated this. It like, annoyed the shit out of me. Obviously it’s a thing made for 3 year olds, and I am in my 30s, but I dunno dog, I played Crystal Pony Tale Adventures which was made for 3 year old girls and really admired it. This is just brainless inane bullshit.

It’s called Learning With. You will not learn anything. It’s called Educational. You will not learn anything. This is jingling keys at its VERY finest. When the game tells you to, you must waggle the wiimote so that the character does the action for the minigame. There are like, 4 of them, with 2 different “Pooyoos” you can play as, an elephant, and a bunny.

I know it’s like shooting fish in a barrel, but I want to compare this to Sesame Street. They’re both for little kids, but whereas Sesame Street feels like artisinal crafted childrens content that actually cares about kids learning something and using their brains, this just feels like Cocomelon. It’s there to distract the parents for 5 fucking minutes.

They made four of these things. Three for the Wii, and one for DS. I only bothered to master this one. I got all my points elsewhere. There is literally no reason to play this stupid thing.
